title: cooking up a superhero sim this weekend, still early. any potential?
author: Square-Yam-3772

comments.author: PotataTomata
comments.body: Plenty honestly, the genre is wide open when it comes to Superman-style games.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I think I may go for a pure simulator and just let players have fun destroying stuff and fight some villains.

replies.author: PotataTomata
replies.body: You have options, I'd say find a game or 2 you really want use them as a reference and blend those into one

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
my personal take is that players are not going to try to grind/progress in a small indie game with no brands attached. I may add a main story quest still but mostly its just open world sim with small events. 

my goal is that is probably just creating a simulator that is fun for \~1 hour. 

well, we will see how it goes

comments.author: hammackj
comments.body: What made your models? I have yet to generate a face was wasn’t shit.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
you can get on tripo or get a decent local model if you plan to generate 3d models

I am just rolling with premade assets for this project
